label: Double-skin milk
note: The skin that forms on cooled boiled milk is lifted aside, the milk is beaten with egg white and sugar and poured back under it, and steaming grows a second skin; a dessert, not a cream

about.text: A milk dessert from Daliang in Shunde, Guangdong, now eaten across Guangzhou, Hong Kong and Macau: boiled buffalo milk forms a skin as it cools, egg white sets the milk beneath, and a second skin forms after steaming.
